newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Shiva rally lifts options trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Shiva rally lifts options trade.

text.p: Investors took advantage of a pop in shares of Shiva Corp to either get in or out of options positions, traders said Wednesday.
By 1000 CST/1600 GMT, nearly 1,000 of the Shiva December 50 calls traded, with much of that volume from a block trade done as a spread.
The option was up 2-3/4 at 6-3/4 and had open interest of 636 through Tuesday.
The February 40 put traded about 630 contracts, losing 1-1/8 to 1-3/4. Its open interest was 116.
"It's a mixed bag," a trader said of the Shiva options activity, which included several hundred contracts changing hands in the November 40, 50 and 55 calls.
Other than the 630 February puts that traded, Shiva puts were quiet.
"A lot of people are getting in because of the opening (rally) and a lot of people are getting out, just scalping," the trader said.
He added that some investors who had taken long positions at far lower levels were taking profits.
Shares of the telecommunications equipment supplier were ahead 4-5/8 at 53-3/8 on turnover of around 1.4 million.
Options traders said that from a chart perspective, the stock appeared to be breaking out. It rallied 2-1/4 Tuesday.
"There's no news out on it," a trader said. "It's just at a critical level when you look at it on a graph."
He added, "It broke through and just looks tremendous."
